newsitem.title: USA: Voters elect nine to state treasurers posts - NAST.
newsitem.headline: Voters elect nine to state treasurers posts - NAST.

text.p: Voters elected six Democrats and three Republicans to state treasurer posts in Tuesday's elections, National Association of State Treasurers said.
Six of the nine treasurers were incumbents.

Pennsylvania Republican Barbara Hafer apparently defeated Mina Baker Knoll, daughter of departing state treasurer Catherine Baker Knoll, in a tight race, NAST said. State officials said Hafer's victory is unofficial because some counties have not yet been tallied.
Democrats John Perdue of West Virginia and Mike Murphy of Washington also will be serving their first terms after defeating opponents, NAST said.
Reelected to new terms were Democrats Bob Holden of Missouri, Harlan Boyles of North Carolina, Kathi Gilmore of North Dakota and Jim Hill of Oregon, NAST said.
Also reelected were Republicans Ed Alter of Utah and Jim Douglas of Vermont.
In other elections, former Louisiana Treasurer Mary Landrieu was elected to the U.S. Senate, according to preliminary figures, NAST said.
